items.description: Benny Amón is a prominent and passionate classic jazz and New Orleans drummer and bandleader. Benny lived full time in New Orleans from 2011-2021. In New Orleans, Benny performed regularly at Preservation Hall, Snug Harbor Jazz Bistro, The Palm Court Jazz Cafe, and aboard the Steamboat Natchez. He has toured the United States, Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Japan, Belgium, Germany, Denmark, and Sweden
